svg.title: The frame dies. The heap block does not.
svg.desc: Blank version of the sketch “The frame dies. The heap block does not.” with all labels removed, for drawing from memory. Two panels of the same call shape. On the left, make_buf returns a pointer to a 32-byte heap block; the make_buf frame is crossed out but a green arrow shows the block still alive and now owned by main. On the right, c() returns the address of a local int z; the frame is crossed out in red and the pointer in main now aims at bytes the next call will reuse. Below, the measured stack budget and a struct-padding comparison of 24 versus 16 bytes.
svg.text: The frame dies. The heap block does not.
